state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the daily meal allowance for a standard travel day with an approved client dinner today? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q2: What is the relocation lump sum for an employee relocating to another country in their third month of employment today? (answer in EUR)
- Q3: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan today? (answer in EUR)
- Q4: What mileage rate applied to a business trip in a private petrol car on 2026-04-15? (answer in cents per km)
- Q5: What is the nightly lodging limit for a standard business trip today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per night)
- Q6: What is the purchase approval threshold for a regular department's purchase from a supplier with a framework contract today? (answer in EUR)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: nightly lodging limit a standard business trip
state.step_intent: Find the nightly lodging limit that applies to: What is the nightly lodging limit for a standard business trip today (2026-10-13)?

passages.source: HB-23 §2 | Travel policy: lodging — Standard nightly lodging limit | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-07-01 to the day before 2026-02-01 · superseded by: HB-25
passages.text: The nightly lodging limit for business travel was 205 EUR per night, including taxes and city fees. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule.

passages.source: HB-04 §2 | Memo: nightly lodging limit exceptions — Exception for business trips to Zurich, Geneva or Oslo | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-07-01
passages.text: For business trips to Zurich, Geneva or Oslo, the nightly lodging limit is 250 EUR per night instead of the standard amount. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim.

passages.source: HB-25 §2 | Travel policy: lodging — Standard nightly lodging limit | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-23
passages.text: The nightly lodging limit for business travel is 175 EUR per night, including taxes and city fees. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header.

passages.source: HB-11 §5 | Policy FAQ — Current nightly lodging limit | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard nightly lodging limit? A: 175 EUR per night, as set in HB-25 §2 (effective 2026-02-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-04.

passages.source: HB-04 §3 | Memo: nightly lodging limit exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-07-01
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to contractors; they follow the standard nightly lodging limit in HB-25 §2. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner.
